description: This file contains a Python module for parsing Android logcat logs, defining a LogLine class, and functions to process log files, extract log lines, and handle log processing states.

classes.name: LogLine
classes.description: Represents a single line of Android logs with attributes for timestamp, UID, PID, TID, level, tag, text, and process reference.

methods.name: ParseLogcat
methods.description: Parses a log file object, yields LogLine objects, and handles chatty log lines by cloning previous entries.

methods.name: ParseLogcatInner
methods.description: Internal generator that reads a log file object, parses lines based on regex patterns, and yields LogLine objects.

methods.name: LogLine.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a LogLine instance with optional attributes for log line components.

methods.name: LogLine.__str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LogLine.

methods.name: LogLine.__eq__
methods.description: Checks equality between two LogLine instances.

methods.name: LogLine.clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the LogLine instance.

methods.name: LogLine.memory
methods.description: Estimates memory usage of the LogLine object.
